about: Every idea Daniel gave for Last Fire, each with a task and five marks: BUILT (the code exists), TESTED (a robot test passes), SEEN (Claude looked from the player's spot, screenshot saved), PAD (works on the controller), PLAYED (the robot player went through it in a real run). Done only with all five. Every mark carries its proof; sim/checklist_verify.mjs erases any mark whose proof is missing.
